value.question: What information must a trial listing contain?
What information must a trial listing contain?
value.draft: A trial listing must include the trial title and unique identifier to ensure proper recognition and tracking. It should also outline the eligibility criteria and study design to inform potential participants about the requirements and structure of the trial. Contact details are necessary for communication purposes, and the recruitment status should indicate whether the trial is currently recruiting, completed, or closed. This information helps researchers and participants make informed decisions about involvement in the trial.
